transcript.text: Hi everyone, before I finalize and send the specs to production for Aria Vale's remote segment, I need to check with our broadcast engineer and rights manager. Are there any production requirements or clearance issues we need to address for the live 20-minute stream segment? I want to make sure we have everything covered before I approve the package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a critical production issue. My post-rehearsal network test showed that the venue cannot maintain reliable two-way latency for a live performance. However, it can reliably play an artist-approved file — but the file must be exactly 7 minutes or shorter, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. I completed this test after the last production meeting and haven't entered the result in the production log yet. This means the currently planned live 20-minute segment is not feasible from a technical standpoint.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Maya, I have clearance requirements to flag. My written distributor confirmation, which I received this morning while the clearance file was being updated, permits Aria Vale's appearance only in the United States and Canada. The stream must be geoblocked everywhere else. Additionally, the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance.' These are binding conditions from the distributor that need to be reflected in the final specifications you send to production.
transcript.speaker: A3
